About This Document

What The Advanced Color Imaging Books Provide

Advanced Color Imaging on the Mac OS describes how to enhance your application's color capabilities using the Palette Manager, the Color Picker Manager, the ColorSync Manager, and the Color Manager. It's companion book, Advanced Color Imaging Reference, documents the constants, data types, and functions your application uses to provide color support.
